page.notes: Greek words in the Lifta and Magifter entries are transcribed as best read from the scan; "γράμμun" and "μήςωρ" are doubtful and may contain errors. The Lifta line reads "Glossis" split across lines in the original; the left-column word "Iam)" at the top is a line fragment from the previous page and is kept as printed. Words like "Cur:id" and "Dier,ipfaFera" follow the printed line breaks. Several entries use italic for the German equivalents, which were not marked as italic here for simplicity. Uncertain letters in German glosses (e.g. "Vlam", "Vlock") may be affected by the scan's quality.
